card: ROLE: Pirate commander operating a counterfeit planet, a spacecraft-carrier disguised as a planetary body.
TRAIT: Commands a force of 100,000 Ostrov-class armored mini-fighters deployable from the counterfeit planet.
TRAIT: Uses the counterfeit planet as a mobile staging platform for large-scale fleet ambushes.
